caseNameFull: N. W. Palmer v. Racheal King
summary: Error, to the Supreme Court of the State of Oklahoma.

opinions.text:
Per Curiam.

Dismissed for the want of jurisdiction upon the authority of § 237 of the Judicial Code, as amended by the Act of September 6, 1916, c. 448, § 2, 39 Stat. 726, Mr. C. S. Arnold for plaintiffs in error. Mr. Elmer D. Means for. defendants in error.
